name: noon-showcase-video
description: Deterministic pipeline that renders the Noon product showcase video

scripts.music: node scripts/timeline.mjs && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --python 3.12 music/compose.py
scripts.sfx: vite build stage --config stage/vite.config.ts && node scripts/cues.mjs && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --python 3.12 music/sfx.py
scripts.render: node scripts/timeline.mjs && vite build stage --config stage/vite.config.ts && node scripts/render.mjs
scripts.render:preview: node scripts/timeline.mjs && vite build stage --config stage/vite.config.ts && node scripts/render.mjs --preview
scripts.thumbnail: vite build stage --config stage/vite.config.ts && node scripts/thumbnail.mjs
scripts.make: pnpm vo && pnpm music && pnpm sfx && pnpm render && pnpm mix && node scripts/thumbnail.mjs
scripts.draft: node scripts/proxies.mjs && node scripts/timeline.mjs && pnpm music && pnpm sfx && node scripts/render.mjs --draft && node scripts/mix.mjs --video out/video-draft.mp4 --out out/noon-showcase-draft.mp4
